extracted.name: Cranberry-Jalapeño Relish
extracted.description: Borrowing from the flavors of the Southwest, this uncooked cranberry-jalapeño relish uses jalapeño, lime, cilantro, and cumin to add a twist to a classic.
instruction_lines: In a mixing bowl, combine cranberries, orange juice, onion, cilantro, garlic, jalapeño, lime juice, cumin, and salt.
Stir together and chill 2 hours before serving.
